title: Reconstruction from a cofinal family of finite clopen partitions
statement:
Use the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Let $P$ be a compact Hausdorff totally disconnected space. A finite clopen partition is a finite set of pairwise disjoint nonempty open and closed subsets with union $P$; the empty partition of the empty space is allowed. Let $J$ be a small nonempty collection of finite clopen partitions of $P$, ordered by $i\le j$ when $j$ refines $i$. Assume that $J$ is directed and that every finite clopen partition of $P$ has a refinement in $J$. Let $P_i$ be the discrete finite set of blocks of $i$, let $q_i:P\to P_i$ be the block projection, and let $r_{ji}:P_j\to P_i$ be the containing-block map for $i\le j$. Define
$$L=\{(B_i)\in\prod_{i\in J}P_i:r_{ji}(B_j)=B_i\text{ for all }i\le j\}$$
with the subspace topology from the product of the discrete $P_i$. Then $L$ is Hausdorff and the canonical map $\phi:P\to L$, $\phi(x)=(q_i(x))_i$, is a homeomorphism. More explicitly, the partitions in $J$ separate distinct points of $P$, and every compatible family $(B_i)\in L$ has intersection $\bigcap_{i\in J}B_i$ consisting of exactly one point, namely $\phi^{-1}((B_i)_i)$. This includes $P=\varnothing$, when $L=\varnothing$.

proof.text: The compatibility subspace is Hausdorff by the product and subtype T2Space instances, since every DiscreteQuotient has the discrete topology. The canonical map is already defined using ofLE_proj, and continuous_pi followed by Continuous.subtype_mk proves continuity from the continuous quotient projections.

Suppose the projections of x and y agree at every index in J. For an arbitrary discrete quotient Q, cofinality gives i in J with i <= Q. Apply ofLE to equality of the i-projections and simplify with ofLE_proj to obtain equality of the Q-projections. Mathlib DiscreteQuotient.eq_of_forall_proj_eq now gives x=y. Contraposition gives the stated point separation, and equality of canonical-map values gives injectivity by evaluation at each index. This directly uses Mathlib quotient separation in place of constructing a separating two-block partition.

For a compatible tuple b, put C_i = proj_i inverse({b_i}). Each C_i is closed by DiscreteQuotient.isClosed_preimage, compact as a closed subset of compact P, and nonempty by proj_surjective. If j <= i, ofLE_proj and compatibility show C_j is contained in C_i. The assumed directedness of J therefore makes this family downward directed. The hypothesis J.Nonempty supplies the nonempty indexing type. Apply the compact closed intersection result in its directed Mathlib form IsCompact.nonempty_iInter_of_directed_nonempty_isCompact_isClosed to obtain x in every C_i. Its coordinate equalities give canonicalMap(x)=b by function and subtype extensionality, proving surjectivity. This argument also handles empty P: any proposed tuple would force a point in its nonempty closed blocks.

The canonical map is continuous and bijective, its source is compact and its target Hausdorff. Apply isHomeomorph_iff_continuous_bijective, the Mathlib declaration of the compact-Hausdorff-bijection leaf, and bundle it using IsHomeomorph.homeomorph. The resulting homeomorphism e has the canonical map as its underlying function by definition.

A point x belongs to every selected block of b exactly when canonicalMap(x)=b, by coordinate extensionality. Applying injectivity of e and e.apply_symm_apply turns this into x=e.symm(b). Conversely e.apply_symm_apply gives membership in every block for e.symm(b). Set extensionality yields the required singleton equality. Finally, if P is empty, a tuple b would give the impossible point e.symm(b), proving the limit empty without a separate construction.

The cofinal-subfamily variant needs two arguments beyond 08ZY, and the delivery writes out both: step 2 separates points via a clopen C from lem-weil-pbc-profinite-clopen-basis, the two-block partition {C, P\C} and cofinality in the right direction; step 4 gets finite upper bounds from i0 plus directedness, so B_j is contained in each B_i and every finite intersection is nonempty, and lem-sfb-compact-closed-finite-intersection (J small) gives the point. Step 1 (P empty, so L empty via i0), step 3 (cylinder preimages are unions of blocks, L Hausdorff as a subspace of a discrete product), step 5 (bijectivity) and step 6 (lem-weil-pbc-compact-hausdorff-bijection with U=P, V=L) are correct. All three cited nodes are mathlib leaves whose statements match their use. I tested P empty, a point, two discrete points and the Cantor set with dyadic partitions. lem-sfb-compact-discrete-quotient-realization and lem-pe-profinite-partition-incidence-limit are not duplicates. The only flaw is that step 2's source names 08ZZ where 08ZY uses 08ZN, which is harmless. No fixes.

lean.statement: theorem cofinal_clopen_partition_reconstruction (P : Type u) [TopologicalSpace P] [CompactSpace P] [T2Space P] [TotallyDisconnectedSpace P] (J : Set (DiscreteQuotient P)) (hne : J.Nonempty) (hdir : ∀ i j : J, ∃ k : J, k.val ≤ i.val ∧ k.val ≤ j.val) (hcofinal : ∀ Q : DiscreteQuotient P, ∃ i : J, i.val ≤ Q) : T2Space (cofinalClopenPartitionLimit J) ∧ (∀ x y : P, x ≠ y → ∃ i : J, i.val.proj x ≠ i.val.proj y) ∧ (∃ e : P ≃ₜ cofinalClopenPartitionLimit J, (∀ x : P, e x = cofinalClopenPartitionMap J x) ∧ ∀ b : cofinalClopenPartitionLimit J, (⋂ i : J, i.val.proj ⁻¹' {b.val i}) = {e.symm b}) ∧ (IsEmpty P → IsEmpty (cofinalClopenPartitionLimit J))

reviewed_lean.note: Node differs from side-live only by the added lean field; lean.statement is verbatim in the file. Clause by clause: compact, T2 and totally disconnected P with nothing extra; DiscreteQuotient = finite clopen partition (empty partition for P empty); Mathlib's reversed refinement order used consistently in hdir, hcofinal and compatibility; hne matches the node's nonemptiness; L is a concrete subtype of the product of discrete stages with ofLE as containing-block map; phi = (proj x)_i via ofLE_proj; conclusions are T2 L, point separation, a homeomorphism pinned to phi, the block intersection equal to {e.symm b}, and IsEmpty P -> IsEmpty L. Edge cases checked: empty P, empty J excluded, one-point P. Helpers are real data, listed in lean.declarations, with source and blueprint docstrings; proof is sorry with the six-step docstring; no pro-etale substitute. Not a duplicate of Profinite.asLimit, exists_of_compat or the parent's TopCat.limitCone. Report has both required sections. No compile run: nothing changed.
